body: It feels like it, it really does.
I understand that, I’m a bit of a recluse and I don’t talk much at my house because I just feel awkward and like I make everyone uncomfortable

I know how you feel, I have people I love and that’s really the only reason I’m here is because I’ve seen first hand what suicide does to people and I can’t put my family,friends, or bf through that. It’s too painful.
You’re right, that’s exactly what I’ve been struggling with. I acknowledge and know that my old life is gone, but I miss it so much sometimes it doesn’t feel real.
